title: I visited someone else's mall?
content: Something interesting happened last night. I don't know if it's because I've been reading this sub or what, but I've been visiting the same mall for over 20 years and last night I visited an entirely new mall I've never been to. It was very modern and vibrant, busy, and surrounded by a modern Midwest city with some shady areas more to the south (I spent hours here and went for a drive). A nice food court on the north end of the mall next to an indoor car dealership next and a movie theater. All on one floor. Didn't go to the bathroom. I got an aerial view at one point, the mall is rectangular, oriented north-south, with an elevated freeway just north of the mall. Sound familiar to anyone? See a big middle aged bearded man carrying a baby through your mall last night?
